prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a stunning premium motion design storyboard for 8x Social's website footer. The reference is the previous monochrome storyboard. User says it is too bland and explicitly asks for VIBRANT COLORS flowing through the dots like a continuous stream AFTER the original 8 has converted to dotted infinity. Keep the stone page, black type, actual footer layout, broad calligraphic asymmetrical infinity with two large unequal tapered negative spaces. Elevate ONLY the animated dot artwork with bold sophisticated chromatic motion and subtle layered depth.

Landscape 3:2 high-resolution editorial board. Top 60% one large beautifully resolved website footer composition: dominant large dotted infinity left two thirds, stationary right column heading "Explore 8x" with five rows original serif 8x prefix: "8x Careers", "8x Sale", "8x Social", "8x Research", "8x Next", tiny "Placeholder" beside Next. Original 8x social at lower left, "Build your network." and orange arrow lower right. Calm warm stone #e9e5dc background, carbon typography. Board title "An endless current." and subtitle "Colour moves through the dots." outside the webpage composition.

Main artwork: individually visible small round dots, with clearly separated gaps, arranged into a dense elegant calligraphic infinity. Dots move along coherent curved lanes around BOTH loops, cross through the central junction and continue around the other loop. Rich saturated vermilion-orange leading head, followed by hot coral/magenta, electric violet, deep cobalt and luminous cyan tail. These are FLOWING GRADUATED COLOUR BANDS WITHIN THE DOTS, not six fixed coloured zones. Show the main hero at a gorgeous peak moment with a vibrant moving colour current winding around much of the infinity, and some carbon dots ahead/behind preserving contrast and structure. Colour feels bold and richly printed, not washed out. Subtle near/far depth from three closely registered dot layers, gentle travelling wave and just perceptible breathing. At the central crossover one stream passes slightly over the other, shown by dot scale and occlusion, without a solid bridge. No neon bloom, no glowing pipes, no extruded noodle, no particle fog. No continuous surfaces: every part of infinity consists of crisp discrete dots. Outer silhouette remains stable and recognizable throughout, apertures open. Background and text NEVER change colour. Tasteful kinetic brand sculpture, digitally achievable layered motion, extremely refined.

Bottom 40%: FOUR clear large sequential frames on same stone background, no card borders. All four frames show the fully formed dotted infinity, same scale and position. Accurate visible PROGRESSION of the same colored wave around the shape; don't simply change entire mark color.
Frame 1 label "01 / DOTS FORMED": mostly black infinity with orange-coral leading packet just entering lower left curve, a violet-blue tail starting.
Frame 2 label "02 / CURRENT CROSSES": colored packet follows left loop up and through central crossing, spreading orange coral violet cobalt cyan behind it; some carbon areas remain.
Frame 3 label "03 / FULL FLOW": vivid current wraps through right loop and back toward left, dominant beautiful multicolor infinity, same tonal family as top hero.
Frame 4 label "04 / CONTINUOUS LOOP": crest advances back around left, previous right arc recedes to blue and carbon, showing a seamless traveling cycle, no reset flash. Add fine curved graphite directional arrows ONLY in empty apertures of lower panels, as diagram annotations, never in main website.
One short annotation below: "Flowing colour · breathing depth · continuous motion".
Critical: avoid a static rainbow gradient stamped over the same four frames. We must clearly see different positions of the orange leading head in the four frames, and multicolor trails following a looping path. No scatter, confetti, broken shape, giant glowing dots, glass, metallic beads, dark page, extra UI cards or full-page transitions. Preserve reference's refined quiet page layout while making the infinity spectacularly vibrant and alive.
